posts.text: For folks who may be confused: No one filed to challenge me in the election. So I have automatically won, unopposed.

posts.text:
I would’ve much rather had an opponent. Voters always deserve a choice. It’s unfortunate that the Republican Party couldn’t get someone to run on their vision in FL10. 

I’m still running a big campaign. Knocking tens of thousands of doors and engaging with people.


Peter Schorsch (@PeterSchorschFL)
